# #2436: Patch: Immutable is a valid buff target for field spells
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

All field spells may gain "Immutable" as a valid buff from buffing cards

### Acceptance

Field spells now can gain the "Immutable" keyword when buffed.

### Blocked by, part of

_No response_

### Difficulty (a guess)

Not sure (the planner rates it)

### Priority

No priority

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-7` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41000023538)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

A Buff's keyword row may give every Field Spell **Immutable** as well as Indestructible, so "Field spells now can gain the Immutable keyword when buffed". Done means four things. The engine constant holds both keywords. The spec says so in a new ruling, R2436000, which amends R1748001, R386, §6.1 and §6.3. A test named after R2436000 proves it, and the two tests that assumed Indestructible was a Field Spell's only keyword are updated. The golden traces are re-blessed and a pending patch fragment claims the cards the classifier names.

## Files to touch

|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/config.rs` | change | `TUNE_FIELD_SPELL_KEYWORDS` gains `KeywordKind::Immutable`; its doc comment |
| `crates/engine/src/effects/tune.rs` | change | comments only: module header (lines 22–24), `non_unit_candidates` doc (lines 328–331) |
| `crates/cards/tests/cross/buff_priorities.rs` | change | header comment, helper `living_bomb`, two tests updated, new test `r2436000_…` |
| `crates/engine/tests/golden/games.jsonl` | change | rewritten by `cargo jackioh golden bless` (27 lines), never by hand |
| `spec/rulings/R2436000.md` | new | the ruling |
| `spec/pending/2436.md` | new | its §11 paragraph |
| `spec/rulings/R1748001.md` | change | `cards` + an "Amended by" paragraph |
| `spec/rulings/R0386.md` | change | keyword clause + `cards` |
| `spec/06-keywords.md` | change | §6.3 Nerf row (line 170), §6.1 Immutable row (line 32) |
| `crates/cards/patches/pending/a-buff-may-give-a-field-spell-immutable.json` | new | written by `cargo jackioh patches`, `player` note by hand |

Do not touch: `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` (never run `cargo jackioh spec index`), `crates/cards/catalog.json`, any card script, `crates/ai/`, `apps/web/` (the constant is not exported; `apps/web/src/wire/` stays unchanged, which the planner confirmed), `BUILD.md` (it does not list this constant), `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`.

Governing spec: §6.3 Nerf and Buff (`spec/06-keywords.md` lines 170–171), §6.1 Immutable (line 32). Rulings: R1748001 (a Field Spell's keyword row), R386, R23 (Immutable stops every Buff and Nerf: `tune.rs` `menu_of`), R781001 (its targeting half: `restrictions::immutable_in_play`), R442, R129, R1160, R767000.

## Steps

1. **`crates/engine/src/config.rs`** (line 493–494). Replace those two lines with:
   ```rust
   /// R1748001: the keywords a Buff's keyword row may add to a Field Spell, in this order; R2436000 added
   /// Immutable after Indestructible.
   pub const TUNE_FIELD_SPELL_KEYWORDS: &[KeywordKind] = &[KeywordKind::Indestructible, KeywordKind::Immutable];
   ```
   Keep the order: seeded draws depend on it. No other engine code changes: `non_unit_candidates` already reads the constant, skips kinds the card holds, and a card holding Immutable gets no menu at all.

2. **`crates/engine/src/effects/tune.rs`**, comments only.
   - Lines 22–23: `is Indestructible for a Field\n//! Spell, and Pierce` becomes `is Indestructible or Immutable\n//! for a Field Spell (R2436000), and Pierce`.
   - Lines 328–331, the doc of `non_unit_candidates`:
     ```rust
     /// R1748001: the keywords a Buff may add to a card that is no Unit, in this order: Indestructible and
     /// Immutable to a Field Spell (`TUNE_FIELD_SPELL_KEYWORDS`, R2436000), and Pierce and Lifesteal to a
     /// Spell or a Field Spell that deals damage (`CardDef.deals_damage`, `TUNE_DAMAGE_KEYWORDS`), each only
     /// while it lacks it. Nothing for a Trap, a Field Trap or any other card.
     ```

3. **`crates/cards/tests/cross/buff_priorities.rs`**. The planner ran this exact code; it passes, and fmt and clippy are clean.
   - Header line 5: `//! one (R1748002).` becomes `//! one (R1748002). Since issue #2436 a Buff may give a Field Spell Immutable too (R2436000).`
   - Add this helper just above `#[test] fn r1748000_a_cry_number_is_out_of_reach_on_the_field`:
     ```rust
     /// Living Bomb face-up in p1's backrow, on `seed`.
     fn living_bomb(seed: &str) -> Scenario {
         scenario(json!({
             "seed": seed,
             "p1": { "hand": [FILLER], "backrow": [{ "def": LIVING_BOMB, "faceUp": true }] },
             "p2": { "hand": [FILLER] },
         }))
     }
     ```
   - In `r1748001_a_buff_gives_a_field_spell_indestructible`, replace its opening `let mut s = scenario(json!({ … }));` (4 lines) with:
     ```rust
         // R2436000: its keyword row draws Indestructible or Immutable, on a seed that draws Indestructible.
         let seed = seed_where("living-bomb-indestructible", |seed| {
             let mut s = living_bomb(seed);
             tune(&mut s, LIVING_BOMB, TuneDirection::Upgrade);
             has(&s, LIVING_BOMB, KeywordKind::Indestructible)
         });
         let mut s = living_bomb(&seed);
     ```
     Then replace `// Indestructible already, it has nothing left to gain.` and the `assert!(rows(…).is_empty());` after it with:
     ```rust
         // Indestructible already, it has Immutable left to gain (R2436000).
         assert_eq!(rows(&s, LIVING_BOMB, TuneDirection::Upgrade), [TuneRow::Keyword]);
     ```
     After its last line, `assert_eq!(s.card(LIVING_BOMB).zone.z(), ZoneName::Field);`, add:
     ```rust
         // Its next Buff has Immutable alone to give, with no draw (R129).
         tune(&mut s, LIVING_BOMB, TuneDirection::Upgrade);
         assert!(has(&s, LIVING_BOMB, KeywordKind::Immutable));
     ```
   - Directly after that test, add:
     ```rust
     #[test]
     fn r2436000_a_buff_may_give_a_field_spell_immutable_and_nothing_tunes_it_after() {
         // Its keyword row draws Indestructible or Immutable, on a seed that draws Immutable.
         let seed = seed_where("living-bomb-immutable", |seed| {
             let mut s = living_bomb(seed);
             tune(&mut s, LIVING_BOMB, TuneDirection::Upgrade);
             has(&s, LIVING_BOMB, KeywordKind::Immutable)
         });
         let mut s = living_bomb(&seed);
         assert!(!immutable_in_play(s.state(), s.card(LIVING_BOMB)));

         let events = tune(&mut s, LIVING_BOMB, TuneDirection::Upgrade);

         assert!(has(&s, LIVING_BOMB, KeywordKind::Immutable));
         assert!(!has(&s, LIVING_BOMB, KeywordKind::Indestructible));
         assert!(events.iter().any(|event| matches!(
             event,
             GameEvent::Upgraded {
                 change: TuningChange::Keyword {
                     keyword: Keyword::Immutable,
                     added: true,
                     ..
                 },
                 ..
             }
         )));
         // Face-up on the field it is Immutable in play: no Spell, Field Spell or Field Trap targets it (R781001).
         assert!(immutable_in_play(s.state(), s.card(LIVING_BOMB)));
         // And no Buff or Nerf changes it again (R23): neither has a row, and another Buff leaves it as it is.
         for direction in [TuneDirection::Upgrade, TuneDirection::Degrade] {
             assert!(rows(&s, LIVING_BOMB, direction).is_empty(), "{direction:?}");
         }
         let tuned = s.card(LIVING_BOMB).tuning.clone();
         tune(&mut s, LIVING_BOMB, TuneDirection::Upgrade);
         assert_eq!(s.card(LIVING_BOMB).tuning, tuned);
     }
     ```
     `immutable_in_play` comes in through `jackioh_engine::testkit::*`, which re-exports the whole engine. Add no import.
   - In `r1748002_a_buff_places_a_plague_counter_and_a_nerf_removes_one`, change the first comment to:
     ```rust
         // Granted Indestructible, it has Immutable alone to gain (R2436000): a Buff draws among its keyword
         // row, its Activate's count (the X row) and the plague row, on a seed that draws the plague row.
     ```
     Change `[TuneRow::X, TuneRow::Plague]` (the Upgrade rows assertion) to `[TuneRow::Keyword, TuneRow::X, TuneRow::Plague]`. Leave the rest as it is.

4. **`spec/rulings/R2436000.md`** (new), exactly:
   ```markdown
   ---
   id: R2436000
   title: "A Buff may give a Field Spell Immutable (issue #2436)"
   cards: "§6.1 Immutable, §6.3 Nerf and Buff; R23, R129, R386, R442, R767000, R781001, R1160, R1748001, C #62, C #74"
   proven_in:
     - crates/cards/tests/cross/buff_priorities.rs
   ---
   Since issue #2436 a Buff's keyword row offers a Field Spell Immutable as well as Indestructible (`TUNE_FIELD_SPELL_KEYWORDS`, Indestructible then Immutable), each only while the card lacks it, one drawn uniformly when both are open ([[R442]]) and none drawn when one is ([[R129]]); a Field Spell that deals damage draws among those two, Pierce and Lifesteal ([[R1748001]]). The owner asked for it on the issue. A Unit still draws from [[R21]]'s pool, which leaves Immutable out, and a Spell, a Trap and a Field Trap gain no Immutable from a Buff.

   The keyword is `tuning`, as every Buff's is ([[R386]]), so the Field Spell is Immutable for every rule from then on, in every zone: no later Buff or Nerf changes it and nothing is drawn for one ([[R23]]), no Vanilla, Transform or Fuse-onto reaches it, and while it is face-up on the field no Spell, Field Spell or Field Trap targets it ([[R781001]]). One application adds both keywords only on a card whose text makes Buffs several times as effective ([[R1160]]). A game recorded before the change in which a Buff reached a Field Spell no longer folds to its recorded hash and is refused as `rules_changed` ([[R767000]]). This amends [[R1748001]] and [[R386]]'s keyword clause.
   ```

5. **`spec/pending/2436.md`** (new), one line:
   ```markdown
   **[[R2436000]] lets a Buff give a Field Spell Immutable (issue #2436, 2026-10-30)**: the owner asked that every Field Spell may gain Immutable from a Buff. A Field Spell's keyword row, Indestructible alone since issue #1748 ([[R1748001]]), now offers Immutable after it, so a Field Spell that deals damage draws among four keywords. A Field Spell made Immutable takes no later Buff or Nerf, and while it is face-up on the field no Spell, Field Spell or Field Trap targets it ([[R23]], [[R781001]]); Units keep [[R21]]'s pool, which leaves Immutable out. It takes R2436000, the first number of issue #2436's block, edits [[§6.1]] and [[§6.3]] and amends [[R386]] and [[R1748001]].
   ```

6. **Spec edits** (exact string replacements):
   - `spec/06-keywords.md` line 170: `to a Field Spell Indestructible, and to a Spell` becomes `to a Field Spell Indestructible or Immutable ([[R2436000]]), and to a Spell`.
   - `spec/06-keywords.md` line 32: `"all" effects still reach it | #19r, #66r |` becomes `"all" effects still reach it. A Buff may give it to a Field Spell ([[§6.3]] Buff, [[R2436000]]) | #19r, #66r |`.
   - `spec/rulings/R0386.md`: `Indestructible to a Field Spell, Pierce or Lifesteal` becomes `Indestructible or Immutable to a Field Spell ([[R2436000]]), Pierce or Lifesteal`; in `cards`, `R2261001, R2280000"` becomes `R2261001, R2280000, R2436000"`.
   - `spec/rulings/R1748001.md`: in `cards`, `R21, R386, C #62` becomes `R21, R386, R2436000, C #62`; append a blank line and the paragraph `Amended by issue #2436 ([[R2436000]]): a Field Spell's keyword row offers Immutable after Indestructible, so a Field Spell that deals damage draws among four.`

7. **Golden traces.** Run `cargo jackioh golden bless`, then `git diff --numstat -- crates/engine/tests/golden/games.jsonl`, which must read `27	27`. Then `cargo jackioh golden check` must read 240 of 240. The planner's run changed exactly these games: plain seeds 17, 31, 33, 41, 59, 74, 87, 90, 92, 108, 124, 125, 127, 136, 141, 162, 176, 178, 179, 184, 187, 189, 195 and handicap seeds 202, 209, 220, 237. Their diverged states hold Field Spells with Immutable in their tuning. A different count means something else changed, so stop and find it.

8. **The cards that play differently (the classifier).** `classify` reads commits, and it reads its repository root at compile time. So it runs from a scratch commit in a throwaway worktree, never a commit in this worktree. `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` is set globally, so give each build its own:

   jq -r '.cards | join(",")' /tmp/b2436-classify.json; jq '.rule' /tmp/b2436-classify.json

   As a cross-check only, the acting cards at the golden divergences suggest families such as classicplus-070, classicplus-071, classicplus-073, meditative-034, meditative-035, meditative-082, meditative-083, meditative-087, meditative-097, stinkyscape-026, stinkyscape-116, stinkyscape-161 and stinkyscape-t-drone-interceptor. Claim the classifier's `.cards`, not this list: CI fails a missing claim and an extra one alike.

   ```sh

The classifier shows <the .cards list> playing differently." --plays <the .cards list, comma-separated>
   ```
   Add `--rule` only if `.rule` was `true`. It writes `crates/cards/patches/pending/a-buff-may-give-a-field-spell-immutable.json`. Fill its `player` by hand: `"title": "Field Spells can be Buffed to Immutable"` and `"changes": ["A Buff can now give a Field Spell Immutable as well as Indestructible."]`, the other lists empty (`patches check` passes on this shape; the planner ran it).
   Then copy the fragment into `/tmp/b2436-head/crates/cards/patches/pending/` and commit it there (`git -C /tmp/b2436-head add -A && git -C /tmp/b2436-head commit -qm "scratch fragment"`). Rebuild there as above and run the same `classify` with `--claims` added: it must exit 0. Then clean up: `git worktree remove --force /tmp/b2436-head` and `rm -rf /tmp/b2436-base /tmp/b2436-base-target /tmp/b2436-head-target /tmp/b2436.patch /tmp/b2436-classify.json`.
   If the sandbox refuses the scratch commit, still write the fragment with the cross-check list above. Say plainly in the report that CI's `rust (classify)` must confirm it.

## Tests

- `crates/cards/tests/cross/buff_priorities.rs`:
  - `r2436000_a_buff_may_give_a_field_spell_immutable_and_nothing_tunes_it_after`: a Buff gives Living Bomb Immutable, and the event says so. The card is then Immutable in play, neither direction has a row, and another Buff changes nothing.
  - `r1748001_a_buff_gives_a_field_spell_indestructible` now also asserts that Immutable stays open and the next Buff gives it.
  - `r1748002_…` now expects the keyword row too.
  - All three fail without step 1. Run: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --features jackioh-engine/testkit --test cards buff_priorities` (7 tests).
- Golden: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test golden`.
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200`. The planner's run with the change: 200 passed, 0 failed.

## Done when

- [ ] `TUNE_FIELD_SPELL_KEYWORDS` is `[Indestructible, Immutable]`: a Buff can give a Field Spell Immutable (the acceptance line), proven by the `r2436000_…` test.
- [ ] R2436000, `spec/pending/2436.md` and the edits to R1748001, R386 and §6.1/§6.3 are in; `cargo jackioh spec check` is ok.
- [ ] `games.jsonl` is re-blessed (27 lines) and `golden check` replays 240 of 240.
- [ ] The fragment claims exactly the classifier's families, and `classify --claims` exits 0 (or the report says why it could not run).
- [ ] rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy and the cargo tests checks pass, with `apps/web/src/wire` unchanged. Fuzz 200 passes too.
- [ ] No scratch worktree or `/tmp/b2436-*` left behind.

## Risks

- **Replays and determinism.** The rng draws shift for every Buff on a Field Spell, so 27 golden games and any stored game where that happened change hash. Stored games are refused as `rules_changed` (R767000, stated in the ruling). Re-bless only after step 1, and check the count is 27.
- **Merge queue.** If `main` moves before merging and its golden file or fragments change, merge `main` and bless again. Two fragments must not claim the same card.
- **Hidden information.** There is no new view or event field. A Buff on a hand or deck Field Spell is reported as `upgraded` is today (R440, R311).
- **The stray `ci_scope_runs_…` failure.** It appeared only in the planner's copy without `.git`. It skips ignored paths through `git check-ignore`, so it won't fail in the real worktree.

## Open questions

- The issue's "all field spells" is read as every Field Spell a Buff can reach, the damage-dealing ones included. A damage-dealing Field Spell then draws uniformly among Indestructible, Immutable, Pierce and Lifesteal. The alternative, which this plan rejected, is weighting the keywords or giving Immutable only to Field Spells that deal no damage. The issue doesn't ask for that.
- Units, Spells, Traps and Field Traps still can't gain Immutable from a Buff. The issue names Field Spells only; extending it to them was rejected as out of scope.
